scope.invariant: Cancelled ordinary HTTP never exposes late native failures, and ordinary text/byte responses cross native IPC as bounded metadata plus raw bytes while preserving account/Range/budget/error contracts.
exclusions: Shared source protocols, Userscript implementations and external plugin Gate
Live product/browser/device inspection, commit and push

findings.change: The catch path rechecks the cancellation signal before preserving/mapping any native failure. Success keeps its existing cancellation check and all settlements detach the subscription.
findings.regressions: Late network, timeout, size-recovery and AppError failures normalize to operation-cancelled. Non-cancelled failures retain their original code/detail; normal resolve/reject detach once. Already-cancelled work opens no IPC request.

findings.change: Ordinary http_request now returns tauri::ipc::Response containing a four-byte big-endian JSON metadata length, metadata capped at 1 MiB, and unchanged raw body bytes. The renderer validates the frame, preserves the request body budget, and returns a Uint8Array view for bytes or lossy UTF-8 text preserving BOM.
findings.regressions: One shared fixture binds Rust raw output and renderer decoding, including Unicode metadata/non-UTF-8 bytes. Tests check buffer identity, 1 MiB binary linear framing overhead, oversized/malformed metadata and bodies, text/empty/BOM/error responses, native 100-999 status compatibility and immutable sent-request decoding. Controlled native HTTP checks both bytes/text modes with real CookieStore and Range, Set-Cookie filtering, declared/chunked size recovery, cancellation/timeout socket closure and registry release.
findings.boundary: Command name/ACL, account session/proxy routing and body budgets are unchanged. model::HttpResponse remains the browser-verification DTO; no compatibility reader/alias or shared protocol is added.

checks.detail: Both codecs remain in apps/tauri. No dependency, source protocol, public shared export or IPC alias was added.
Cancellation precedence, subscription detach, immutable sent settings, fixed account IDs/fresh request IDs, native total timeout, size recovery and registry finish are exercised.

Status, headers, UTF-8 text and byte identity are retained. Credential headers remain rejected/filtered; request/response changes add no persistence. TLS dependency advisories are recorded as separate repository blockers below.

Existing require_main/account session/generic omit-loopback guards are preserved. Native fixtures bind CookieStore and Range; exact ACL/live grant acceptance is not inferred. Root lint checks current isolation/mobile boundaries.

Permanent owner tests, shared wire fixture, native local transport tests, bilingual maintained guide updates and production builds cover the repaired scope. Whole-repository formatting and dependency-policy failures are reported separately; this is not full delivery acceptance.
